reason: The hypothesis relies on Ga inducing a dual-phase fcc+BCC structure and this raising coercivity via domain wall pinning, but none of the cited evidence involves Ga or demonstrates that BCC precipitates in an fcc FeCoNi matrix increase coercivity; E3 shows Sn, not Ga, promotes BCC and increases saturation magnetization, not coercivity, while E1 and E2 are unrelated to the proposed mechanism.
premises: Ga doping of FeCoNi promotes BCC phase formation
Dispersed BCC precipitates in fcc matrix enhance domain wall pinning
Domain wall pinning increases coercivity beyond 100 Oe
Low Ga addition maintains high saturation magnetization
